另一种可用写法：普通 SELECT 默认保留重复记录，显式 ALL 不改变结果。

commonErrors.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers),b AS (SELECT customer_id FROM new_customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM old_customers) SELECT customer_id FROM a INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM b ORDER BY customer_id
commonErrors.reason: 对称差为两个方向差集的并集，两者互斥。
